messages:
mira: FYI SAST is spitting a pile of results around direct KMS calls in several client libs. Lots look like false positives where we use our keystore wrapper.

sam: Which rule? I saw some alerts in CI but didn't dig in.

mira: vendor rule KMS_PLAINTEXT_API. Example from the scan: 

```
rule: KMS_PLAINTEXT_API
file: clients/objstore/keystore.go:38
match: "kmsClient.Encrypt(ctx, \"app-data\", payload)"
note: key id appears inline
```

mira: In reality key id comes from config at runtime and wrapper enforces service-level checks. FP.

alex: Two approaches: short-term suppression by path with expiry, or longer term: add metadata-driven checks so scanner can resolve key ownership/metadata and approve findings automatically.

jordan: Metadata-driven sounds better. We could query KMS for key existence and metadata (purpose, labels) and use that to reduce noise. Also correlate with RBAC: service account name prefixes changed in last rotation (sa-storage-*), maybe use that mapping too.

sam: Does scanner infra have access to KMS APIs or audit logs? That's an IAM/privilege question.

devops: We can provision a scanner service account with read-only access to KMS key metadata (not full audit logs). Access to Cloud Audit Logs is more sensitive; need compliance signoff.

compliance: If logs are requested, we need a data minimization argument. Returning only key metadata (creation time, rotation policy, labels) is usually acceptable. Raw audit entries require stronger justification.

ci-bot: CI: 48 SAST findings in branch feature/objstore-kms, failing merge check: https://ci.internal/6789

sast-bot: Proposal: extend rule config with `allow_if_key_has_label` and `allow_if_repo_owner`. Example snippet: 

```
rules:
  - id: KMS_PLAINTEXT_API
    allowlist_filters:
      key_labels: ["managed-by:storage-team"]
      repo_owners: ["storage-team"]
```

mira: Good. Implementation plan: 1) short suppression on clients/objstore/* expiring in 10 days to reduce noise, 2) ENGSEC-1302 to add allowlist_filters to our SCA config, 3) GH Action that precomputes `/tmp/kms_key_meta.json` by querying KMS metadata for keys referenced in repo, caches results.

alex: I'll sketch the GH Action. It should: scan the tree for `keyID` string constants, dedupe keys, call KMS DescribeKey, write out key_id -> labels/rotations. Cache via GH actions cache keyed by repo@sha. Rate limiting is a concern; we'll add exponential backoff.

sam: For correlation with RBAC, can we use recent audit events to show the key is used by production service accounts? That would make a stronger case, but as compliance said, logs are sensitive. Maybe we keep logs access for a second-phase feature.

jordan: Agreed. Phase 1: key metadata only. Phase 2: optional audit correlation for when metadata is ambiguous.

devops: I'll draft an IAM request for scanner-read-only to KMS DescribeKey and list operations, plus a scoped logs-read if ENGSEC signs off later.

mira: For now I'll add a temporary suppression: `clients/objstore/*` until 2025-02-01. I'll log the suppression with the reason and owner.

sast-bot: Suppression recorded: path `clients/objstore/*`, expires 2025-02-01, created by mira. CI re-run recommended.

alex: Also propose a lightweight annotation pattern for PRs touching keystore wrappers so scanner can pick them up: `//sast:keystore-approved owner=storage-team key-pattern=env/*`. Scanner could parse comments as a last-resort allow signal.

sam: Action items recap?

mira: I'll open ENGSEC-1302 with checklist: add allowlist_filters support, GH Action prototype, suppression applied, IAM request drafted, test plan (staging runs, monitor FP rate).

jordan: I'll add required metadata list for the IAM ticket: key id, location, labels, rotation status, creation time. Also propose a small retention filter for any logs if/when we request them.

devops: Will attach IAM drafts to ENGSEC-1302 and propose least-privilege bindings.

compliance: When ENGSEC-1302 lands, we should run a privacy review. Keep logs out of scope for phase 1.

mira: Great. I'll push the suppression and follow up with the ticket and a short rollout timeline. Thanks all.

sam: :thumbsup:

alex: once prototype exists we can flip on the filter in staging and measure delta in noisy SAST results.

mira: noted. I'll update the ticket with measurement criteria.
